name: cadrumo
description: Operate Cadrumo, a deterministic Spanish-tax CLI, as an MCP tool surface: grounded search over the bundled BOE/AEAT legal corpus, situation-keyed guided workflows, and gated execution that never files to AEAT.
long_description: The Cadrumo console exposes a deterministic Spanish-tax CLI to any MCP client. It carries the operator rules, the taxpayer-situation skills, and guided-workflow prompts; a read-only corpus and terminology search for legal grounding; and a human-in-the-loop confirmation gate on every state-changing verb. Live submission to AEAT is permanently impossible — no such tool exists; the taxpayer files outside the app. All financial data stays on-host in encrypted storage; only the conversation and the figures the assistant sees reach the LLM client's provider. The bundle contains the exact Cadrumo root and data-cohort wheels and uses the MCPB UV runtime to provision their platform dependencies.

persona.title: Operator persona
persona.description: The harness persona scoping the tool surface (leave blank for the full surface). One of: coordinator, onboarding, ledger-groomer, classifier, modelo-preparer, verifier, reconciler.

surface.title: Tool surface
surface.description: Which tools the server advertises up front: 'core' (default) advertises the orientation slice plus search/execute; 'full' advertises every verb. Either way the whole verb universe stays reachable through search and execute.

tools.name: cadrumo_harness_load

tools.description: Search the bundled BOE/AEAT legal corpus for grounding.

tools.name: cadrumo_terminology_search
tools.description: Look up a Spanish tax term in the bundled terminology handbook.

tools.name: search
